title: World's top international scorers
brief: Name the ten men who have scored the most goals in official full internationals.

notes.Vivian Woodward: Vivian Woodward's 75 includes amateur internationals; he scored 29 in full internationals for England.
notes.Ali Mabkhout: Wikipedia counts 85 for Mabkhout, RSSSF 84; he is in the ten either way.
notes.Mokhtar Dahari: Dahari's 89 includes Olympic qualifiers that FIFA now recognises.
notes.Kylian Mbappe: Kylian Mbappe had 66 at the end of the 2026 World Cup.

checks: Active players (Ronaldo, Messi, Lukaku, Lewandowski, Kane, Neymar) counted match by match from Transfermarkt's game list up to 19 July 2026 and matched Wikipedia's list as it stood on 9 August 2026, before the September window. Retired players (Daei, Chhetri, Dahari, Puskas) match RSSSF's goal-by-goal pages. Mabkhout: Wikipedia 85, RSSSF 84 (last updated February 2024); either figure keeps him in the ten, above Neymar's 80. Lewandowski and Kane later scored in September and October 2026; those goals are left out.
